summary: Candidate for the Analyst, Total Fund Management (12-Month Contract) role with ~7 years across institutional investment analytics, cash-flow and liquidity modelling, and output validation for multi-asset portfolios. At Moody's Analytics, validates valuation and sensitivity outputs for pension funds, asset managers, and bank treasuries; investigates and escalates discrepancies; and partners with technology teams on workflow enhancements. Strong Python and SQL; CFA charter; dual MSc; detail-oriented with a controls mindset.
core_skills: Trade Lifecycle Familiarity (Rates, FX, Inflation Derivatives)

sections.heading: Output Validation & PnL/Sensitivity Reconciliation
bullets: Holds sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement — independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions, and validates outputs against internal records prior to production release.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — cross-checks sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates and flags discrepancies before release.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics, ensuring accuracy of downstream investment and risk reporting.

sections.heading: Cash Flow, Liquidity & Reporting
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across investment horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding and asset-allocation decisions.
Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities.

sections.heading: Technology Coordination & Issue Resolution
bullets: Serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues — investigates discrepancies, coordinates with downstream technology and operations partners, and drives timely resolution.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls, strengthening operational integrity.
Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds and asset managers migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform — translated investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests and tracked delivery.

Served as technical liaison between front-office users and product/development teams; validated model outputs post-deployment, investigated configuration breaks, and resolved issues with internal technology partners.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe PM — coordinated testing and sign-off across stakeholders.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory reporting requirements with system implementation workflows.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, and PM functions on milestone delivery — built shared requirements documentation and unblocked cross-team dependencies.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors — analyzed funding ratios, duration positioning, and long-horizon balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform — including risk decomposition and attribution.
Presented ALM findings on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients; led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-employer merger.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
